summary: CareGrid V2 FastAPI backend fully tested at http://127.0.0.1:8000. 19/19 pytest tests pass covering: bed matching (HIGH/MEDIUM/404/read-only/step-down inclusion), 4 real operational dataset imports (ops_patients=1000, services_weekly=208, staff=110, staff_schedule=6552), ingestion idempotency (skipped on repeat), live-vs-operational data separation, patient CRUD/PATCH/DEFER regression with audit-log verification, and ML endpoints (status, validation, estimate).
critical_code_review_comments: GET /ml/validation returns metrics nested under a 'metrics' key (not top-level accuracy/precision/etc). Frontend must read data['metrics']['accuracy'] etc. Test statement in review request implied top-level flat fields — clarify contract or flatten if intended.
PATCH /patients/{id} returns {'message': 'no changes', 'changed_factors': []} without previous_score/new_score keys when no field changed. Not strictly a bug but callers must handle that shape.

backend/services/bed_matching.py match_beds_for_patient does not add data_complete guard when required_resources empty — best_match still returned as 'LOW' with 'match cannot be assessed'. Consider returning best_match=None when data_complete=False to avoid misleading UI recommendations.
Ingestion drops rows via df.drop_duplicates().dropna(how='all'); rejected_rows count is only duplicates + all-NA. Consider logging which rows were rejected for auditability.
seed_data_creation: Test creates/updates patient id 'TEST-BEDMATCH' and defers it. Does not clean up (idempotent — re-run tolerates existing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API at http://127.0.0.1:8000 (not port 8001). Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_caregrid_v2.py -v`. The 4 operational CSVs are already imported (SHA-256 idempotent — reimports return status='skipped'). Live /patients demo set is re-seeded on backend restart, so any prior DEFER on P001-P005 may reset. TEST-BEDMATCH persists across runs; PATCH test dynamically toggles severity between 15/25 to force a change.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Minor test-side adjustments made: (1) ml/validation metrics are nested under 'metrics', so test reads data['metrics']; (2) PATCH test now checks current severity and toggles to a different value to guarantee changed_factors.
